articles.author: BTC Digital Ltd.
articles.headline: BTC Digital Ltd. Announces Georgia 10MW Cryptocurrency Computing Infrastructure Approaching Deployment Readiness
articles.summary: BTC Digital reported completed infrastructure construction for its Georgia 10 MW project, with mining equipment deployment expected within approximately two months. Its theoretical capacity projection was not operating capacity already achieved.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original PR Newswire explicitly August 24 07:30 ET.
